description: Agent Card Validator (A2A): given an Agent Card URL or JSON, deterministically validates it against the A2A spec — required fields, skill schemas, endpoint reachability, security schemes, provider transparency — and returns a compatibility_score, schema_errors and warnings. The trust layer for the agent economy. Deterministic, Ed25519-signed. 0.01 USDC via x402 on Base. SYNTHORA. [x402: 0.01 USDC per call on Base; first 3 calls free]
